deploy-bot: Deployment started: release v2026.03.4 -> eu-central-1 (change window 23:00-01:00 UTC). Initial traffic shift plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 20m. Monitoring hooks: latency_p95, 5xx_rate, inference_error_rate. Rollback criteria required in-thread.
maya: Leaving release notes draft in #product. tagging @samir for explicit rollback thresholds and decision tree. assigning @ben to watch dashboards.
samir: Proposed rollback thresholds (simple):
```
- 5xx_rate > 0.5% sustained over 5m -> consider rollback
- p95_latency > 1200ms for 3 consecutive 1m samples -> consider rollback
- inference_error_rate > 0.2% over 5m -> immediate rollback candidate
- any sustained spike in tail latency + user-visible failures -> manual rollback
```
Also add hysteresis: if we see short warmup spike (<2m) don't roll back unless other signals corroborate.
ben: copying thresholds into the release checklist. I'll add a quick dashboard bookmark: `#/dash/r/eu-central-release-v2026-03-4` and set an alert window for 3m sampling.

rachael: note: prefix-cache GC ran at 22:50 in eu-central earlier. watch for increased cold misses for the next 10m.
chris: pin command ready if needed: `redwoodctl rollout pin --service=api --model=reformer-v2 --version=2026-03-03 --region=eu-central-1`.

samir: This breaches the 0.5% threshold. Recommend pinback and rollback to 2026-03-03. If agree, I'll execute with `redwoodctl rollback start --to=2026-03-03 --region=eu-central-1`.

ben: tailing logs now: majority of 5xxs are `RuntimeError: model kv cache OOM` from reformer-v2 workers, stack traces show memory growth after sequence length 1024. Not a DB issue.
chris: Executing pin now (dry-run then apply). `redwoodctl rollout pin --model=reformer-v2 --version=2026-03-03 --region=eu-central-1 --apply`.
